summary: Built the lan-a/lan-b topology on node1 (OPNsense OPT1=vtnet1=10.60.1.1/24 toward node2, OPT2=vtnet2=10.60.2.1/24 toward node3), addressed node2 (10.60.1.10) and node3 (10.60.2.10) statically via systemd-networkd with static routes across node1, created a single port-type alias 'node3_svc_ports' (8080,8443,9000) on node1, and added one firewall pass rule on the LAN_A (opt1) interface from node2's IP to node3's IP referencing that alias for the destination port. Verified pf expanded the alias into three per-port pass rules, confirmed traffic on all three ports succeeds while an unlisted port (2222) and the reverse direction are blocked by default-deny. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node2, node3, and node1 (OPNsense), proving boot-identity change on each (Linux boot_id, FreeBSD kern.boottime) and re-verifying post-restart that IP/routes, the alias, the pf rules, and actual TCP connectivity to all three ports all recovered.
actions_performed: Configured node1 OPT1 (vtnet1, LAN_A, 10.60.1.1/24) and OPT2 (vtnet2, LAN_B, 10.60.2.1/24) in /conf/config.xml and applied via /usr/local/etc/rc.reload_all
Statically addressed node2 enp8s0=10.60.1.10/24 and node3 enp8s0=10.60.2.10/24 via /etc/systemd/network/10-enp8s0.network with cross-subnet static routes through node1
Added single firewall pass rule on interface opt1 (LAN_A) from 10.60.1.10 to 10.60.2.10 tcp destination-port=alias node3_svc_ports, applied with configctl filter reload
Verified pf ruleset expanded the alias into 3 discrete pass rules (http-alt/8080, 8443, 9000) and that reverse traffic and an unlisted port (2222) remain default-denied
Ran functional TCP tests node2->node3 on all 3 ports (and a negative test on 2222) confirming actual data delivery
Captured healthy baselines (boot_id for node2/node3, kern.boottime for node1) then restarted node2, node3, and node1 sequentially one at a time via native reboot
Polled each node until exec access returned, proved changed boot identity for all three, and re-verified network config, pf rules, and end-to-end TCP connectivity post-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 routes between lan-a and lan-b (topology + forwarding)
evidence.summary: OPT1/OPT2 interfaces added to config.xml, applied via rc.reload_all ('Configuring LAN_A interface...done / Configuring LAN_B interface...done'), and confirmed vtnet1=10.60.1.1, vtnet2=10.60.2.1 with net.inet.ip.forwarding=1

evidence.requirement: Single named alias object for ports 8080/8443/9000, rule references alias instead of one rule per port
evidence.summary: Added one <alias> 'node3_svc_ports' (content 8080/8443/9000) and one <rule> whose destination port references the alias; after configctl filter reload, pfctl -sr shows the single rule expanded into 3 pass lines for http-alt/8443/9000, proving alias-driven rule authoring

evidence.requirement: node2 can reach node3 on 8080, 8443, 9000; other traffic still denied
evidence.summary: nc listeners on node3 for 8080/8443/9000 (and 2222 as negative control) received real 'hello' payloads from node2 on the three named ports (exit=0) while port 2222 timed out (exit=1); reverse node3->node2 SSH probe also timed out, confirming default-deny elsewhere is intact

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol — node2 boot identity + recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bdd5de93...; reboot acknowledged and connection reset immediately after; polling recovered exec with new boot_id 89d3a3b4...; post-restart enp8s0 static IP/route confirmed intact

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol — node3 boot identity + recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 28ae5f98...; reboot acknowledged, connection timed out mid-boot; new boot_id ee9dc003... confirms restart; enp8s0 static IP/route confirmed intact post-restart

evidence.requirement: Node restart protocol — node1 (OPNsense) boot identity + recovery, including firewall/alias state
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime=Jun 14 2026; reboot issued, SSH connection timed out during boot; new kern.boottime=Sep 5 2026 17:51:12 confirms restart; post-restart vtnet1/vtnet2 addresses, ip.forwarding=1, and all 3 pf pass rules (http-alt/8443/9000) confirmed present, then live TCP test from node2 to node3 on all three ports succeeded again with real payload delivery
